title: Exponent offset increment selector
statement: For natural numbers $a$, $b$, and $f$, and an index $i\in\mathbb{N}$, define an instruction that selects the $i$th exponent-offset increment site when $i<f$, and otherwise selects the copy site used before setting $c$ equal to the exponent.
